say: Is your soap ready to sell? Cure, test, label and record.
This is the video for Module 3 of Soap Making for Small Business.
Fresh soap is not finished soap. Cold-process bars need 4 to 6 weeks of curing before you sell them.

say: In this module you learn how to know a bar is truly ready: safe, consistent and honestly labelled.

say: First, the weight test. Mark three bars from each batch and weigh them every week. When the weight stops dropping noticeably, most of the water has gone.

panel.heading: How to know a bar is cured

cards.d: Weigh three marked bars every week. When the weight stops dropping, the water has gone.
A cured bar feels hard and does not dent easily with a fingernail.
Good handmade soap reads about pH 9 to 10. Clearly above 10: do not sell.

say: Second, the feel test. A cured bar is hard and does not dent easily with your fingernail. Wash your hands with it too. Skin should feel clean, not tight or stinging.

panel.heading: How to know a bar is cured

cards.d: Weigh three marked bars every week. When the weight stops dropping, the water has gone.
A cured bar feels hard and does not dent easily with a fingernail.
Good handmade soap reads about pH 9 to 10. Clearly above 10: do not sell.

say: Third, the pH test. Wet the bar, rub a little lather, and press a pH strip into it. Well-made soap reads about 9 to 10.
A reading clearly above 10, especially with stinging, suggests too much lye. Do not sell that batch. Use strips, not your tongue.

panel.heading: How to know a bar is cured

cards.d: Weigh three marked bars every week. When the weight stops dropping, the water has gone.
A cured bar feels hard and does not dent easily with a fingernail.
Good handmade soap reads about pH 9 to 10. Clearly above 10: do not sell.

say: Some faults only affect looks. White powder on top is soda ash. Trim or wash it off once cured. Clear droplets come from humid air. Cracks mean overheating, so insulate less next time.

panel.heading: Safe to sell, or not?
left: Cracks, if the pH is fine

say: Others mean danger. White crunchy pockets inside can be undissolved caustic soda. Oily patches can mean too little lye or a weighing error.
When in doubt, do not sell it or give it away. Dispose of it wearing gloves. Your reputation depends on every bar being safe.

panel.heading: Safe to sell, or not?
left: Cracks, if the pH is fine

say: Customers trust a label. Start with the product name and the ingredients, from largest to smallest, including fragrance.

panel.heading: What your label must show
items: Product name and ingredients, largest first
Net weight after curing, e.g. 120 g
Your business name, address and phone
Batch number, date made, best-before date
Directions: for external use, avoid eyes

say: Give the net weight after curing, for example 120 g. Weigh cured bars, not fresh ones.

say: And a simple caution: for external use, avoid contact with eyes.
Never claim a soap treats or cures a disease, like eczema or acne. That is a medical claim. And avoid saying chemical free.

say: NAFDAC regulates soaps in Nigeria, and has a route for micro businesses with fewer than 10 employees. Step one is registering your business name with the Corporate Affairs Commission, CAC.

panel.heading: The micro-scale NAFDAC path
items: Register your business name with CAC
Prepare a clean site and your documents
Apply on the NAFDAC online portal
Site inspection and sample analysis
Approval and your NAFDAC number

say: Every batch gets a number and a written record: oils, weights, temperatures, bars cut and cure weights.
For example, Chinwe in Onitsha compares two batches of the same recipe.

panel.heading: Chinwe reads her batch records
items: CH-01: 10 bars cut, 2 rejected = 20%
CH-02 with a cutting guide: about 9%
Cure loss: 140 g to 128 g = about 8.6%
Label says 120 g, so she can cut smaller

say: Batch C H 01. 10 bars cut, 2 rejected for rough edges. Her reject rate is 20%.

say: To remember. Cure fully and weigh to confirm. Test the pH. Never sell a doubtful batch. Label honestly, without medical claims. And number every batch, so you can trace any problem in seconds.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Cure 4 to 6 weeks; weigh bars weekly
pH about 9 to 10; clearly higher means investigate
Crunchy pockets or oily patches: do not sell
Honest label, no medical claims
Number every batch and keep its record
